layout_title: HSLU Courses Skill Tree - Interactive Course Planning
layout_description: Interactive skill tree visualization for HSLU courses. Plan your academic journey with prerequisite tracking and course progression.
page_catalog_unavailable_text: Check your connection and try again.
settings_reset_progress_message: Are you sure you want to reset all progress? This will clear all completed and attended course statuses.
settings_reset_all_data_message: Are you sure you want to reset all data? This will clear all progress AND your course selections. This cannot be undone.
template_load_confirm_message: Your customized study plan will be overwritten. Any custom nodes you've added or courses you've removed will be lost.
sync_description: This device and your cloud account have different progress. Pick one; the other stays saved on this device.
sync_unavailable: Cloud sync unavailable. Changes remain saved on this device.
details_empty_hint: Click on a course to view details and track your progress
details_empty_elective_hint: Click on dashed "Wahl-Modul" nodes to select courses
prereq_ects_progress: {completed} ECTS completed · {project} ECTS from project modules
prereq_not_in_plan: This prerequisite is not in your current study plan
warning_later_message: This course has prerequisites that are scheduled in the same or later semesters. You may not be able to take this course in the current semester.
warning_missing_message: This course requires prerequisites that are not in your study plan. Add the required courses first.
warning_assessment_message: This course requires the assessment stage to be passed but is placed in the assessment stage semesters (1-2 for full-time, 1-3 for part-time).
elective_choose: Choose a course for this slot
assessment_bedingt: Conditionally passed: ≥42 credits with ≥6 credits from project modules
assessment_nicht: Not passed: <42 credits achieved, or ≥42 but <54 credits with <6 credits from project modules
assessment_consequences_bedingt: Can continue studying, but must earn remaining credits within 5 semesters
assessment_consequences_excluded: Students who don't pass definitively within 5 semesters are excluded from the bachelor program
persistence_invalid_backup: This file is not a valid skill-tree backup.
tutorial_welcome_title: Welcome to HSLU Courses Skill Tree
tutorial_welcome_description: This short tour shows you how to explore your study plan, track courses, switch programs, and review your progress.
tutorial_explore_description: Drag or scroll to move around the skill tree, and use the controls to zoom. Courses are arranged by semester and connected by prerequisites.
tutorial_course_description: Select any course to view its details and prerequisites. In the details panel, mark it as attended or completed to track your status.
tutorial_program_description: Choose your degree program, study model, start year, and semester, then load the matching curriculum.
tutorial_progress_description: Open the ECTS summary to see passed, completed, and failed credits overall and by module type.
tutorial_sync_description: Sign in with GitHub to sync your progress and study plan between devices. Already signed in? Review the sync status and sign out from this menu.
tutorial_open_source_description: This project is open source. jackra1n/hslu-courses-skill-tree Curricula are maintained by hand, so double-check anything important against official HSLU sources, and please open an issue if something looks wrong.
